headline: The Chinese company Infinigence AI, which makes software for running AI models across many kinds of chips, has raised 2.3 billion yuan in a Series C funding round.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: a sizeable funding round, but based on company materials, with no investors named and company-only performance figures.
importance_line: The round gives a Chinese company that helps AI run on both Chinese and foreign chips more money to grow, which matters to firms running large AI services, but the usage and efficiency figures are the company's own and unchecked.
summary: TechNode reports, from company materials issued on 12 Oct 2026, that Infinigence AI, founded in 2023, has completed a Series C round (a later-stage private funding round) of 2.3 billion yuan, bringing its total funding to 4.3 billion yuan; the company makes software that lets AI models run efficiently across different chip platforms, including mixed training on Chinese and international processors. The company says its platform links 37,000 petaflops (a measure of computing speed) across 16 chip types and that daily use of its model service grew 40-fold between December 2025 and July, figures that come from the company and are not independently checked.
notes: TechNode's own short report from company materials; investors are not named in the article.
